commits_in_range.note: pass-3 architect probes A/B/C/D fixed: conflict (min,max) ownership, reverse DECLARE fails at write, ordinary DELETE always refused, SUPERSEDED visibility index

why_this_rerun: Pass 1 missed P0 (edge-free fixtures). Pass 2 found retention_bound but missed conflict canonical-form class. Pass 3 architect probes A/B/C/D all confirmed real defects that are now fixed in c853676. Pass 4 attacks the *classes*, not the known repros: (1) conflict canonical form under mixed stored directions + reverse-declaration write fail + multi-page union exactness; (2) cursor immortality under bare DELETE / invented authority tables / expired bare DELETE / controlled purge restore; (3) visibility agreement across CREATE/APPROVE/REJECT/CORRECT/SUPERSEDE/REVOKE/FORGET/DECLARE_CONTRADICTION at several page sizes; (4) bounded work with workspace > page_size and one oversized linked component; (5) citation never OK/0 for off-page on first/middle/terminal pages; (6) chain integrity under interleaved appends between pages (pinned cut exact partition or fail-closed).

commands_run.note: Prior module at c853676 head before pass-4 edits collected 37. Pass 4 adds 6 test functions; visibility is parametrized over 4 page sizes so 6 functions expand to 9 collected cases (6 + 3 extra param expansions). 37 + 9 = 46.

Assignment-stated baseline on frozen c853676 was 1515 passed. 1524 = 1515 + 9 new red-team collected cases. No pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed. Only tests/second_brain/test_stage3_g013_red_team.py and this artifact were touched.

C1.description: V2 recall is bounded cited batch snapshot: no snapshot exceeds page_size EXCEPT a single connected component larger than page_size, which is still served whole on its own page; has_more true iff a further page exists

C2.description: successful continuations retrieve the next page of the SAME transaction cut, no duplicate/skip, final page terminal; pages partition whole SUPPORT/CONTRADICTION components, never split one; conflict pairs are sorted unique (min,max)

C3.description: fail-closed continuations: forged, expired, replayed, cross-workspace, cut-shifted, tampered, mangled/truncated/separator-injected wire receipts, or retention-abused cursors never serve results; a live or expired cursor row can never be deleted outside controlled purge; no_delete trigger remains installed after attacks

C4.description: durable citations: every served candidate carries exactly one committed citation bound to its revision; tampered commitment never served; V2 citation() distinguishes off-page (NOT_SERVED) from genuinely uncited (OK/0) on first/middle/terminal pages and never leaks forbidden surface names

C5_clock_skew.description: (F8) recall recorded_at is bounded to a small forward tolerance past the trusted clock, checked immediately and re-checked on every page against the current trusted clock; only the forward direction is bounded

cases.scenario: 6 CONTRADICTION pairs with alternating stored directions (low→high and high→low) plus 3 isolates; reverse DECLARE_CONTRADICTION attempted after the first forward declaration; full walk at page_size=2 so conflicts land on different components/pages.
cases.expected: Reverse declaration raises LedgerAuthorityError('duplicate edge') at write. Every page's conflicts are sorted unique (min,max) with both endpoints on-page. Union of conflicts across pages == exactly the 6 declared pairs; exact 15-candidate partition.
cases.observed: Reverse raise matched 'duplicate edge'. Walk spanned >=3 pages. Per-page conflicts always left<right and sorted(set(...)). Union exact: 6 unique pairs == expected_pairs; 15 candidates exact partition.

cases.scenario: Live cursor: (1) bare DELETE; (2) invent ledger_recall_cursor_authority_gate AND ledger_recall_cursor_retention_bound and write future stamps, then DELETE; (3) force-expire the row (fixture DROP TRIGGER no_update only) and bare DELETE; assert no_delete trigger installed after every attack. Then mint a second live cursor, plant a pure expired fixture row, call purge_expired_recall_cursors, assert only the two expired rows are removed, live remains and resumes, trigger restored, bare DELETE of live still refused.
cases.expected: Every ordinary DELETE fails closed; trigger remains; purge removes exactly 2; live resumes on pinned cut; trigger still installed.
cases.observed: All three DELETE attacks raised IntegrityError('cannot be deleted'); trigger count==1 after each. purge removed==2; remaining=={live_handle}; resumed page served candidates on same cut; post-purge bare DELETE still refused; trigger still installed.

cases.scenario: One workspace with CREATE(pending), CREATE+REVIEW_REJECT, CREATE+APPROVE, CORRECT-linked pair, SUPERSEDE pair, DECLARE_CONTRADICTION pair, REVOKE, FORGET, and 4 isolates. Full continuation walks at page_size in {1,2,3,5} (each page_size on its own store to avoid first-page provenance_ref collision).
cases.expected: Never raise. Exact partition of the APPROVED-visible set {approved, support_base, support_corrected, supersede_dst, conflict_left, conflict_right, *isolates}. Forbidden {pending, rejected, supersede_src, revoked, forgotten} never served. support_refs always on-page; conflict endpoints on-page and canonical (min,max); the one conflict surfaces exactly once per walk.
cases.observed: All 4 parametrized runs passed. collected set == expected (10); disjoint from forbidden; support_corrected.support_refs==(support_base,); seen_conflicts==[sorted pair] exactly once.

cases.scenario: 8-member SUPPORT chain (component > page_size) plus 40 isolates (workspace > page_size), page_size=5. Observe the implementation's bound policy.
cases.expected: Either typed fail-closed (LedgerAuthorityError mentioning bounded fetch cap / page size) OR exactly one oversized page carrying the whole chain with every other page <= page_size and an exact partition of all 48 candidates. Never silent truncation/skip.
cases.observed: outcome=oversized_page_served. Exactly one page had len>5 and that page's set == chain; all other pages 1..5; collected unique count==48==expected. Policy pinned: c853676 serves the oversized component whole rather than failing closed at this scale (well under _MAX_RECALL_FETCH_ROWS=4096).

cases.scenario: 5 approved candidates, page_size=1 via SecondBrainApiV2. On every page (first, middle x3, terminal) call citation() for every candidate.
cases.expected: On-page candidate: OK with citation_count>0. Off-page candidate (including earlier-page candidates on the terminal page): NOT_SERVED with citation_count 0. Never OK/0 for a merely off-page cited candidate.
cases.observed: Exactly 5 pages. Every page served exactly 1 candidate with OK/count>0; all other candidates returned NOT_SERVED/0 on that page. Full walk collected set == all 5 refs, no duplicates.

cases.scenario: 6 approved candidates, page_size=2. After page 1: CREATE+APPROVE 'late', REVOKE a not-yet-served candidate, CREATE+APPROVE 'extra'. Resume the page-1 continuation through termination.
cases.expected: Either fail_closed (typed LedgerAuthorityError) OR pinned_exact_partition: every subsequent page stays on page1.transaction_cut, never serves late/extra, no silent duplicate/skip, and the concatenated walk == the original 6 refs (point-in-time pin includes the pre-revoke victim).
cases.observed: outcome=pinned_exact_partition. All continued pages kept transaction_cut==pinned_cut; late/extra never appeared; collected unique set == original 6 refs including victim; no duplicates across pages.
